nodes.speaker: Elder Willow
nodes.npcText: Greetings, traveler. Dark times have fallen on our village.

nodes.speaker: Elder Willow
nodes.npcText: Goblins stole the Sun Crystal from the shrine last night!

choices.text: I'll help you get it back.

nodes.speaker: Elder Willow
nodes.npcText: Bless you! Head north toward the mountains.
